notes: !!⚠️ THIS CONSTRAINS WHICH WALL CAN HOST THE BED, and the vault already carries it. The maker (Freedom, YT_qMGSfO-glvc) states it directly: «надёжное крепление кровати возможно ТОЛЬКО К БЕТОННОЙ СТЕНЕ. Для других стен существует опорная рама. Она распределяет нагрузку НА ПОЛ.» !! THE CRITERION IS THE MATERIAL, NOT THE STRUCTURAL ROLE - the vault corrected its own 'load-bearing' paraphrase on 2026-09-15. A load-bearing block wall is still not concrete. A second maker allows aerated block with CHEMICAL anchors, six-point fixing - four angle brackets high, two concealed low - «они держат в любой поверхности». So block is workable, but ONLY with the fixing specified in ADVANCE, which makes this a rough-stage decision rather than a joinery one. !! CONSEQUENCE FOR THE LAYOUT: the R-series concrete walls are the unconditional candidates; a G-series block wall costs either chemical anchors or a support frame that eats floor depth.

notes: !!⚠️ I GOT THIS WRONG TWICE AND THE OWNER CORRECTED BOTH. FIRST, I ranked by the longest FACE length, which is the SOLID dimension - clear span plus owned corners. A bed attaches to the CLEAR span, and `clear_mm` is the length of record. Every figure I quoted was too long: R8 is 1490 where I said 1790, R9 is 1490 where I said 1750, R2 is 1675 where I said 1925. Standing rule 9 names this exactly. SECOND, I then narrowed to the living/kitchen zone and reported ONE candidate. The owner: «we have actually two possibilities - R6 in one bedroom and R7 for the living area, which I potentially can consider as a temporary bedroom.» The scenarios need a sleeping place in BOTH the small bedroom and the transformable zone, so two candidates is the right answer and one was an artefact of my own framing. !! R6 AND R7, BOTH 1750 CLEAR, ARE THE ONLY PLACES IN THE FLAT THAT TAKE A 1600 WALL BED ON CONCRETE. 1800 fits neither - it misses by 50 mm before the cabinet is counted. R2 (kitchen) and R3 (entrance end) are excluded by USE, not by size. !!⚠️ AND THEY ARE NOT THE ONLY PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE POSITIONS, which a page of mine claimed. R3 (2740) and R2 (1675) are excluded by PRESENT USE, not by structure - a zoning change re-opens them. R8/R9 (1490) are excluded by DI-007, a design decision. G7/G8 offer 3250 of block each and PAR-BED-SUBSTRATE explicitly permits chemical anchors or a floor-bearing frame, so the middle bay is UNATTRACTIVE, not prohibited. The honest claim is: the two currently ELIGIBLE, UNCONDITIONAL concrete candidates in intended sleeping zones.
